decision: Directive merges require evaluate green: on deftai/directive, parent MUST NOT squash-merge a PR unless deft pre-pr:run --evaluate is green for that PR tip (repo/base/head/body-hash binding). Workers MUST run deft pre-pr:run, observe required phases, and --complete before push/PR-open. Consumers stay soft until they enroll forge skip-as-miss (#5631).

governingRule.description: Prescribed pre-PR completion is controller-issued private-store authority; author tokens and skill-open are not passes. Dogfood Lane 1 parent evaluate gate until leftover #5631 makes skip a required-check miss.

alternativesConsidered.option: Wait for #5631 forge required-check miss before any dogfood enforcement
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Leaves Directive merges without an evaluate gate while Limb 5 enrollment remains open; soft skill honor stays unauditable.

alternativesConsidered.option: Enroll consumers with the same required-check miss by default
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Operator-owned repo-scoped rulesets; deposit must not auto-flip consumer merge protection (#1517).

alternativesConsidered.option: Treat worker DONE claims or opening the pre-pr skill as sufficient
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Controller evaluate denies author tokens, checkboxes, and skill-open; private store is authoritative (#4912).

whyWinner: Lane 1 is repo-local process: per-PR-tip evaluate green on Directive only, no consumer forge enrollment. Durable until #5631 ships App-pinned skip-as-miss on deftai/directive.
revisitTrigger: When #5631 lands live skip-as-required-check-miss on deftai/directive, revisit whether parent evaluate remains mandatory or becomes advisory backup.
